Barbie® celebrates the 65th anniversary with a gorgeous collectible doll! She styles her blond hair in a glamorous waterfall ponytail and wears a full ballgown inspired by an iconic piece of Barbie heritage. With a display stand and fashion booklet this 1oz pure silver legal tender colorized coin shaped as the Barbie® Blue Sapphire 65th Anniversary Doll is a timeless collectible! Limited mintage of only 3,000 coins.
